g.text: Tangaroa: original 300 x 180 x 120 grid, 201 frames
T1-T3 mark the times discussed in TMTM Fig. 15. They are temporal reference guides; no feature-group identity is inferred from a matching time.
T1: paper: feature-group separation | T2: paper: spatial group context | T3: paper: departing group leaves domain
Time axis: frame index. Original spatial data below (same input protocol; full spatial window):
P/R share the complete fixed reference axis. A directional projection does not encode complete 2-D/3-D geometry. No baseline method panels are included.
